hero.headline: I build <hl1>fast</hl1>, <hl2>reliable</hl2> products for the web.
hero.subheadline: Full Stack Developer with 3 years of experience, working remotely with a U.S. product team — from React interfaces to the APIs and automation behind them.

contact.title: Let's build something together
contact.intro: Open to new full-time opportunities with teams that ship in English. Based in Brazil, comfortable overlapping with U.S. hours.

about.title: About me
about.body: I'm a Full Stack Developer with 3 years of experience, focused on front-end engineering with React, Next.js and TypeScript, and comfortable extending into APIs, databases and Python automation. I work remotely with a U.S. product team, collaborating daily in English across product, design, backend and data — shipping production applications end-to-end. At Voting Buddy, I maintain a shared component library used across 20 features and own the address-based search flow from UI to API integration. I'm completing a Computer Science degree in December 2026, which keeps strengthening the fundamentals behind the code I ship.

cleanCode.title: Clean code
cleanCode.body: Shared component libraries, consistent patterns, code reviews — built to be maintained by a team, not just shipped once.

dataAutomation.title: Data & automation
dataAutomation.body: Python scripts that replace manual, repetitive work — from politician-record lookups to automated status checks.

shipping.title: Shipping to production
shipping.body: Not just prototypes: real users, real deploys, on Vercel and Docker, with CI/CD in the loop.

bullets: Build and maintain the product frontend in React and TypeScript, including a shared component library used across 20 features — cutting duplicated UI code and keeping the interface consistent as the product grew.
Own the address-based search flow (ElectorMap / Downballot Finder) end to end: UI, API integration, and the loading, empty and error states behind it.
Automated internal data-processing workflows in Python, replacing a manual one-by-one lookup of politician records and saving roughly 10 hours per week.
Represented the company at Web Summit 2025 and 2026, presenting AI/ML civic tech to international stakeholders.
Developed and maintained an internal web application using HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
Replaced manual reporting with an interactive Qlik Sense dashboard for an 8-person team, saving roughly 2 hours per day of manual data collection.

recommendations.title: What people say about working with me

orbisFinance.title: Orbis Finance
orbisFinance.desc: Personal finance platform in production, replacing spreadsheet workflows with structured monthly and daily dashboards. Includes a CSV import pipeline for card statements, scheduled due-date notifications, and per-user authentication with row-level security.

districtLookup.title: District Lookup Tool
districtLookup.desc: Resolves an address to its legislative districts using public government geospatial data, renders boundaries on an interactive map, and generates a sample ballot of elected offices.

statusMonitor.title: Status Monitor Service
statusMonitor.desc: Automation service in production that polls a government status page, detects state transitions and sends alerts, with deduplication logic and scheduled execution via GitHub Actions.
